newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere shares rise on higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Solidere shares rise on higher turnover.

text.p: Solidere shares rose on higher turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday. A shares rose slightly to $113.625 from Wednesday's $113.50 and B shares also rose to $116.5 from $114.75.
Turnover in Solidere shares was 20,818 shares up from Wednesday's 15,645 and value was $2,388,703 from $1,775,537.
Also traded on the BSE were 500 Ciments Libanais shares at $1.21875, unchanged from Wednesday.
There was no trade in the shares of the three other listed companies: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.23 percent to 82.71 and the BLOM stock index rose 0.61 percent to 966.47.
